# Myndgerð fyrir Líffræði

Búið til 28. október 2026 með innbyggðri ImageGen-myndgerð. Upprunalegar myndir: 1024 × 1536 PNG með alfa-gegnsæi. WebP-skrárnar eru þjappaðar birtingarútgáfur án breytinga á myndramma. Myndirnar eru stílfærðar fræðslumyndir, ekki nákvæmir atlasar.

## 01-skin.png — lokaprompt

Create a single full-length illustration of a friendly ADULT classroom anatomy model wearing plain sage green athletic shorts, intended as the SKIN chapter illustration for an interactive science encyclopedia. Front view, relaxed symmetrical A-pose, arms slanted slightly away from torso, hands next to thighs, legs slightly apart. Warm medium tan skin, short dark brown hair, simple kind face. Entire figure from head to feet fully visible centered on a true transparent background. Portrait 2:3 composition, top of head at4% of frame, soles at96%, fingertips range22%-78% of width. Refined gouache and pencil scientific book illustration, softly shaded dimensional form, subtle paper-like paint on skin, crisp edges, beautiful earthy terracotta and sage palette. Proportions seven head heights. Opaque modest knee-length green shorts remain clearly visible. No organs visible on this outer skin chapter. No labels, text, arrows, background, scenery, border, platform or shadow. Keep consistent geometry for subsequent educational muscle and skeleton chapters.

## 02-muscles.png — lokaprompt

Viðmiðunarmynd: 01-skin.png. Gegnsær bakgrunnur.

Create an educational MUSCLE CHAPTER illustration that matches this reference's exact full-body front-view pose, body proportions and 1024x1536 portrait framing. Show the same ADULT man as an artificial science-museum teaching model. He wears a FULLY OPAQUE red terracotta anatomical demonstration BODYSUIT from neck to ankles with illustrated muscle-group shapes printed on the suit: pectorals, segmented abdominal muscles, upper-arm biceps, front thigh quadriceps and calf muscles, with fine cream linework indicating muscle fibers. Plain opaque sage-green athletic shorts OVER the bodysuit. Face hands feet are intact normal tan skin, short dark brown hair and kind face same as reference. No uncovered torso skin. This is a clean non-graphic teaching costume, not real tissue or an injury. Painterly encyclopedia illustration matching reference. All body visible head to feet. True transparent background, no ambient glow, no platform or scene. No text labels arrows or border.

## 03–07 — sameiginleg byrjun og endir

Viðmiðunarmynd: 01-skin.png. Eitt aðskilið myndgerðarkall fyrir hverja mynd. Sameiginleg byrjun + kaflalýsing + sameiginlegur endir mynda lokaprompt hvers kalls.

**Byrjun:**

Use case: illustration-story. Create an original educational illustration asset for a student human-body flipbook. The input is a STYLE AND POSE REFERENCE. Preserve exact same front-view relaxed A pose, full body proportions, location within portrait canvas, short hair where appropriate, fingertips and feet positions, and refined painterly encyclopedia illustration style. Entire figure head to feet visible.

**Endir:**

True transparent background; remove the original brown ambient glow completely. No scene, text, labels, arrows, border, platform, cast shadow. This is a simplified conceptual illustration, not a diagnostic anatomy atlas. Dry, calm, non-graphic classroom teaching model. Same 1024x1536 portrait framing as reference.

### 03-skeleton.png

SKELETAL chapter: replace the figure with a complete clean ivory classroom teaching skeleton, full front view skull, rib cage, sternum, spine, pelvis, arm and leg bones, hands and feet. Pale ghosted outline of the original figure around it for alignment. No shorts needed on skeleton. Warm ivory bone, subtle graphite shading. No organs. This is a friendly dry museum teaching model.

### 04-lungs.png

RESPIRATORY chapter: turn the original adult figure into a very pale translucent ivory anatomical teaching model wearing the same sage shorts. On the torso clearly display two muted lavender lungs in the upper chest, trachea at center of neck branching into bronchi, curved diaphragm immediately below lungs. Only respiratory system highlighted. Skin silhouette extremely pale, enough to see highlighted organs unobstructed. Do not include other internal organs.

### 05-circulation.png

CIRCULATORY chapter: turn the original adult figure into a very pale translucent ivory anatomical teaching model wearing the same sage shorts. Highlight a small anatomically shaped muted red heart in center of chest slightly toward viewer's right, red arteries and blue veins branching through neck, arms, torso, legs, clearly visible across the shorts as a teaching diagram overlay. Only circulatory system highlighted. Subtle silhouette, simplified clean network, no other organs.

### 06-digestion.png

DIGESTIVE chapter: turn original adult figure into very pale translucent ivory anatomical teaching model wearing same sage shorts. Highlight digestive organs in muted warm terracotta and rose: esophagus descending centrally from throat, large liver in upper abdomen on VIEWER'S LEFT, stomach on VIEWER'S RIGHT below chest, small intestines coiled centrally below stomach surrounded by larger colon. Organs clearly unobstructed, visible over shorts when needed. No other highlighted organ systems.

### 07-nerves.png

NERVOUS chapter: turn original adult figure into a very pale translucent ivory anatomical teaching model wearing same sage shorts. Highlight brain inside head, spinal cord down torso center, fine branching peripheral nerves throughout arms hands legs feet in clear amber-gold. All branches clean and simplified, visible across shorts as an overlay. No other highlighted organ systems.
